name: Ray Marching with In/Out-Scattering and Density Scaling
definition: A ray marching algorithm that accounts for four light-particle interactions: absorption, out-scattering (attenuation), emission (ignored), and in-scattering (energy gain). It distinguishes between homogeneous (uniform coefficients) and heterogeneous (spatially varying density) participating media.
summary: This deterministic ray marching method computes single scattering radiance in participating media by iteratively accumulating in-scattering and out-scattering contributions, distinguishing homogeneous from heterogeneous media via density scaling.
